card.title: IPhone 13 Pro and 13 Pro Max No Touch Problem

source.title: IPhone 13 Pro and 13 Pro Max No Touch Problem

claims.statement: iPhone 13 Pro / Pro Max no touch with normal connector readings is usually a faulty capacitor on the touch boost line: C8901 (plus C8903 on Pro Max).
To check the boost output, power the board at 3.8–4.2 V, inject 1.8 V at minimal current into the boost IC enable pin (#49 per JC Drawing) and measure output pin #54; no output = proceed.
The shorted cap must be replaced (not just removed); if the short remains, replace U8900 too.

procedure: Force-enable the touch boost and measure its output.
Split the board; check/replace C8901 (and C8903 on Pro Max).
Replace U8900 if the short doesn't clear.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
